craft_notes: Sthāyin: vismaya at sundered-varied shine — stain and shine in one breath throughout. Grade-by-grade between-states; no-heart-rest kept negative. Rejected: (a) softening stain → killed. (b) countless→many → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: STAIN-too OF the-SUNK-en … GRADE by-GRADE.

lines: Stain too of the sunken — no heart-rest so —
between too, countless states stand, grade by grade.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aśuddhir api magnānāṃ naivaṃ hṛdayaviśramaḥ | atrāntare 'py anantās syuḥ sthitayas tāratamyataḥ

reads_against.argmap: What states stand between? → Immersed-impure unresting; infinite states by degrees between.
